# Awesome SkyCD

SkyCD plugins are distributed by their publishers as NuGet feeds described by a manifest. This list links to publisher-owned manifests; it does not host, mirror or review plugin binaries.

## Contents

- [Feature plugins](#feature-plugins)
- [File format plugins](#file-format-plugins)
- [Metadata plugins](#metadata-plugins)
- [Sample plugins](#sample-plugins)


## Feature plugins

Small additions that make the app more pleasant to live in, like a built-in web browser opened from the Tools menu. They do not read files; they add a handy tool or a missing window to the interface.

- [Web Browser](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.Feature.WebBrowser) - Opens a built-in web browser.


## File format plugins

Open catalogs saved by other disk-cataloguing tools and import their contents. The same plugins read and write playlists, so an existing collection can move in and, where supported, be saved in the format another program expects.

- [abeMeda](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.FileFormat.AbeMeda) - Imports abeMeda and NeoFinder catalogs.
- [Basenji](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.FileFormat.Basenji) - Imports Basenji databases.
- [Broken X Disk Manager](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.FileFormat.BrokenX) - Opens and saves Broken X databases.
- [Cathy](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.FileFormat.Cathy) - Imports Cathy catalogs.
- [CD Catalog Expert](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.FileFormat.CDCatalogExpert) - Opens and saves CD Catalog Expert files.
- [CdCat Hyper Catalog](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.FileFormat.CDCat) - Imports CdCat catalogs.
- [CDCollect](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.FileFormat.CDCollect) - Opens and saves CDCollect catalogs.
- [CDPlayer.ini](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.FileFormat.CDPlayer) - Imports CDPlayer.ini databases.
- [Disk Explorer Professional](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.FileFormat.DiskExplorer) - Imports Disk Explorer catalogs and reports.
- [DiskBase](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.FileFormat.DiskBase) - Imports DiskBase catalogs.
- [DiskCatalogMaker](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.FileFormat.DiskCatalogMaker) - Imports DiskCatalogMaker catalogs.
- [Easy Disk Catalog Maker](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.FileFormat.EasyDiskCatalog) - Imports Easy Disk Catalog databases.
- [GCstar](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.FileFormat.GCstar) - Imports GCstar collections.
- [Katalog](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.FileFormat.Katalog) - Imports Katalog collections.
- [Librer](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.FileFormat.Librer) - Imports Librer disk databases.
- [MyCatalogue](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.FileFormat.MyCatalogue) - Imports MyCatalogue databases.
- [Playlists](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.FileFormat.Playlist) - Reads and writes playlists.
- [Smart CD Catalog PRO](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.FileFormat.SmartCDCatalogPro) - Imports Smart CD Catalog PRO files.
- [TAR Archive Index](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.FileFormat.Tar) - Lists TAR archive contents.
- [Tellico](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.FileFormat.Tellico) - Imports Tellico collections.
- [Virtual Volumes View](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.FileFormat.Vvv) - Imports Virtual Volumes View exports.
- [Where Is It?](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.FileFormat.WhereIsIt) - Imports Where Is It? reports.
- [WinCatalog](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.FileFormat.WinCatalog) - Imports WinCatalog databases.


## Metadata plugins

Surface the details stored inside your files, such as tags, titles, authors, durations and dimensions. When a file can be shown, these plugins also draw a preview or thumbnail, so a folder of unknown files is easy to scan.

- [3D Model Metadata and Preview](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.Metadata.Models3D) - Shows 3D model details and a thumbnail.
- [AbiWord Document Metadata and Preview](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.Metadata.AbiWord) - Reads AbiWord files without AbiWord installed.
- [Apple iWork Document Metadata](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.Metadata.IWork) - Reads Pages, Numbers and Keynote details.
- [Archive Contents](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.Metadata.Archives) - Lists what is inside archives.
- [Audio Tags, Cover Art and Audio CDs](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.Metadata.Audio) - Reads audio tags, cover art and CD details.
- [Disk Images](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.Metadata.DiskImages) - Lists files inside disk images.
- [eBook Metadata and Covers](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.Metadata.EBook) - Reads e-book details and covers.
- [eComic Metadata and Covers](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.Metadata.EComic) - Reads comic details and covers.
- [Email Metadata](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.Metadata.Email) - Reads email and mailbox details.
- [Executable File Facts and Icons](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.Metadata.Executable) - Reads version info and the program icon.
- [File Metadata](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.Metadata.FileMetadata) - Reads tags, comments and ratings.
- [Font Metadata and Previews](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.Metadata.Fonts) - Shows font names and previews.
- [Game Engine Project and Asset Metadata](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.Metadata.GameDev) - Reads game project and asset details.
- [Image Preview and Metadata](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.Metadata.Image) - Shows dimensions, tags and previews.
- [Jupyter Notebook Metadata](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.Metadata.Notebook) - Reads notebook details without running code.
- [Microsoft Office Document Metadata](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.Metadata.Office) - Reads Office document details.
- [Microsoft Works Document Metadata and Preview](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.Metadata.Works) - Reads Works documents and shows text.
- [OpenOffice Document Metadata](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.Metadata.OpenOffice) - Reads OpenDocument and OpenOffice details.
- [P2P File Hashes](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.Metadata.Hash) - Computes eD2k, TTH and SHA-256 hashes.
- [Sequencer Metadata](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.Metadata.Sequencer) - Reads music projects and tracker files.
- [Video Metadata and Poster Frames](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.Metadata.Video) - Reads video details and poster frames.
- [Video Project Metadata](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.Metadata.VideoProjects) - Reads Premiere, After Effects and Resolve projects.
- [Volume Serial Number](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.Metadata.Volume) - Records disk volume serial numbers.
- [WordPerfect Document Metadata and Preview](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.Metadata.WordPerfect) - Reads WordPerfect documents and shows text.
- [XMP Sidecar Metadata](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.Metadata.Xmp) - Reads keywords and ratings from XMP files.


## Sample plugins

Small reference plugins that show how the plugin API and interface contracts fit together, including an options page, a menu command and a blocking dialog. Read them before writing your own plugin, or copy one as a starting point.

- [Sample Configuration](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.Sample.Config) - Shows an embedded options page.
- [Sample Menu](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.Sample.Menu) - Shows a Tools menu command.
- [Sample Modal](https://github.com/SkyCD/SkyCD.Plugin.Sample.Modal) - Shows a blocking export dialog.


## How this list works

Every entry links to the publisher who makes the plugin. SkyCD reads that publisher's manifest, shows the plugin in its built-in browser, and installs it from the publisher's own NuGet feed. Nothing is hosted, mirrored or reviewed here, and a listing is not an endorsement of what a plugin does.

Publishers ship updates through their own feed, not through this list. The list changes only when a plugin is added, moves to a new manifest address, or is removed.

## Reading the list from an app

SkyCD and other clients read the same entries as JSON, published alongside this page:

```text
https://skycd.github.io/awesome-skycd/plugins.json
```

The response is an open, anonymous list of manifest URLs that matches the plugins shown here; an empty list is valid. How a plugin gets listed is described in [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Contributing

Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for inclusion criteria, the submission and review process, source moves, removal policy and the contribution checklist. Delisting affects only this list; it never uninstalls anything from a user's machine.
